location.name: North Goa
location.title: North Goa Luxury Villas & Private Estates
location.tagline: Sun-drenched beaches, heritage architecture, and tranquil palm-fringed private pool retreats.
location.description: Explore our exclusive collection of 83 luxury handpicked private pool villas in North Goa. Each sanctuary is crafted with bespoke interiors, private pools, dedicated butler service, and tailored coastal experiences.
